title: HW3 ledger.jsonl row
description: Validates ONE line of ledger.jsonl, the append-only record of model calls that survives a kill. The agent writes a call_started row before it sends a model request. It writes a call_finished row with the provider usage after the reply. Graders check the rules across lines. The ts field goes up from row to row. A call_id has one call_started row and at most one call_finished row, after the call_started row. Both rows have the same attempt. It equals the attempt of the last resume event before the model_call event in trace.jsonl. A call_started row with no call_finished row is open, and an open row is never charged. The budget charge is input + output summed over call_finished rows only. It equals report.json budget.used_tokens. Each call_finished row matches one model_call event in trace.jsonl with the same call_id and usage. The run_id is the run_id of report.json. The cache_read and cache_write counters are recorded when reported and never charged. Extra fields are allowed, except inside usage.

usage.description: Token counters as the provider reported them. No summed total.
